tooltips.type: Selects the sound system type. Use 'csgo_mega' for 3D world sounds (weapons, footsteps, props). Use 'csgo_music' for music, 'csgo_ambient' for map entity zones, 'csgo_surf' for sliding sounds, or 'csgo_movie' for UI video audio.
tooltips.base: Inherits all properties from a parent sound event (for example, 'Weapon_Base'). Any property you set in this event overrides the parent value.
tooltips.value: Sets a numeric value for setter-type sound events (default: 1.0). Standard 3D or music events do not use this property.
tooltips.vsnd_duration: Sets the length of the audio file in seconds (>= 0). The engine usually calculates this automatically during compilation.
tooltips._auto_calc_vnsd_duration_: When true, the compiler automatically calculates 'vsnd_duration' from the audio file. Set to false to keep your manual 'vsnd_duration' value.
tooltips.metadata: Adds engine tags to this sound event, such as ["meta", "localplayeronly"]. Leave empty for normal sounds.
tooltips.volume: Sets the base loudness multiplier (>= 0.0). 0.0 is mute, 1.0 is standard normal volume, and values above 1.0 boost the volume.
tooltips.volume_random_min: Sets the lowest random offset added directly to 'volume' on each play (default: 0.0). For example, if 'volume' is 1.0 and this is -0.1, the lowest resulting volume is 0.9.
tooltips.volume_random_max: Sets the highest random offset added directly to 'volume' on each play (default: 0.0). For example, if 'volume' is 1.0 and this is 0.1, the highest resulting volume is 1.1.
tooltips.pitch: Sets the playback speed and pitch multiplier (default: 1.0). 1.0 is normal speed. 2.0 is double speed (higher pitch). 0.5 is half speed (lower pitch).
tooltips.pitch_random_min: Sets the lowest random offset added directly to 'pitch' on each play (default: 0.0). For example, if 'pitch' is 1.0 and this is -0.05, the lowest resulting pitch is 0.95.
tooltips.pitch_random_max: Sets the highest random offset added directly to 'pitch' on each play (default: 0.0). For example, if 'pitch' is 1.0 and this is 0.05, the highest resulting pitch is 1.05.
tooltips.delay: Waits this many seconds after the event triggers before playing the sound (seconds, >= 0, default: 0.0).
tooltips.priority: Sets the importance of this sound (>= 0, default: 1.0). Higher numbers win when too many sounds or music tracks play at the same time.
tooltips.ducking_bypass: Toggle value (0.0 = off, 1.0 = on). Set to 1.0 to stop the game from lowering this sound's volume during loud gunfire, explosions, or voice chat.
tooltips.preload_vsnds: Loads the audio files into memory when the map starts. Enable this for weapons or common sounds to prevent delay on the first play.
tooltips.vsnd_pause_with_game: Pauses the sound when the player pauses the game.
tooltips.is_ui_sound: Plays the sound directly in the player's headphones (2D) without 3D direction, distance drop-off, or room reverb. Ideal for menu clicks and HUD alerts.
tooltips.voice_culling_threshold: Stops the sound channel to save CPU when its volume drops below this threshold (0.0 to 1.0, default: 0.01).
tooltips.suppression_enable: Reduces loudness and hearing distance when a weapon has a silencer attached (such as M4A1-S or USP-S).
tooltips.suppression_volume_multiplier: Multiplies the volume when silenced. The official CS2 value is 0.07 (multiplies base volume by 0.07).
tooltips.suppression_falloff_multiplier: Multiplies the hearing distance when silenced. The official CS2 value is 0.2 (multiplies hearing distance by 0.2).
tooltips.vsnd_selection_type: Chooses how to pick a file when multiple audio files are listed: 'random' (equal chance), 'random_weighted' (uses 'vsnd_weights'), 'round_robin' (cycles without immediate repeats), or 'sequential' (plays in exact order).
tooltips.vsnd_weights: Sets the relative selection weight for each audio file when 'vsnd_selection_type' is 'random_weighted' (non-negative numbers). Each file's chance equals its weight divided by the total weight (for example, [0.8, 0.2] or [4.0, 1.0] gives file #1 an 80% chance and file #2 a 20% chance).
tooltips.use_fadetime_volume_mapping_curve: Enables 'fadetime_volume_mapping_curve' so the sound fades out smoothly when stopped instead of cutting off instantly.
tooltips.fadetime_volume_mapping_curve: Controls how the volume multiplier (Y) drops over time (X: seconds) after the sound is told to stop.
tooltips.volume_fade_out_input_max: Sets how many seconds a CS2 music track takes to fade out to silence when stopped (seconds, >= 0, default: 1.0).
tooltips.volume_fade_initial_input_min: Sets the start time for the initial music volume adjustment window (seconds, >= 0).
tooltips.volume_fade_initial_input_max: Sets the end time for the initial music volume adjustment window (seconds, >= 0).
tooltips.volume_fade_initial_input_map_min: Sets the volume multiplier at the start of the initial music fade window (>= 0.0, default: 1.0).
tooltips.volume_fade_initial_input_map_max: Sets the volume multiplier at the end of the initial music fade window (>= 0.0, default: 1.0).
tooltips.position: Sets fixed 3D map coordinates [X, Y, Z] in Hammer units (no coordinate range limit). Keep at [0, 0, 0] if a map entity or player provides the position.
tooltips.position_offset: Shifts the sound position by [X, Y, Z] Hammer units from its origin (no range limit). For example, [0, 0, 60] raises the sound 60 units up.
tooltips.position_offset_relative: Rotates 'position_offset' to match the direction the entity or player is facing.
tooltips.use_world_position: Forces the sound to play at the fixed 'position' coordinates instead of following an entity.
tooltips.use_uiposition: Places the sound relative to the listener's head using the 'uiposition' [Left, Forward, Up] offset.
tooltips.position_relative_to_player: Attaches the sound to the listener so it moves with the player. Useful for first-person sounds.
tooltips.use_entity_position_if_local_player: Uses the local player's 3D entity coordinates when the sound is triggered by the local player.
tooltips.set_child_position: Sends this sound's 3D position to its child events ('soundevent_01') so they play from the same spot.
tooltips.randomize_position_min_radius: Sets the minimum radius for randomizing the sound's spawn position (Hammer units, >= 0).
tooltips.randomize_position_max_radius: Sets the maximum radius for randomizing the sound's spawn position (Hammer units, >= 0). Useful for distant thunder or birds.
tooltips.randomize_position_hemisphere: Keeps random positions in the upper half (above the origin) so sounds do not spawn underground.
tooltips.distance_multiplier: Scales the measured distance between the listener and the sound before applying distance curves (>= 0.0, default: 1.0). Values below 1.0 make the sound carry farther; values above 1.0 make it drop off faster.
tooltips.broadcast_distance_override: Overrides the propagation distance during spectator or GOTV broadcasts (Hammer units, >= 0).
tooltips.display_broadcast: Enables special sound range rules for tournament spectators and GOTV broadcasts.
tooltips.use_ambient_entity_position: Plays the ambient sound from a named map entity (such as 'snd_event_point', 'snd_event_sphere', or 'snd_event_orientedbox').
tooltips.ambient_entity_name: Enter the exact name (targetname) of the sound entity placed in your Hammer map.
tooltips.use_distance_volume_mapping_curve: Enables 'distance_volume_mapping_curve' so the sound gets quieter as the player moves away.
tooltips.distance_volume_mapping_curve: Controls how the volume multiplier (Y: typically 0.0 to 1.0) changes with distance (X: Hammer units). Normally starts at 1.0 nearby and drops to 0.0 far away.
tooltips.use_distance_unfiltered_stereo_mapping_c: Enables 'distance_unfiltered_stereo_mapping_curve' to change stereo width by distance.
tooltips.distance_unfiltered_stereo_mapping_curve: Controls stereo spread (Y: 0.0 to 1.0) by distance (X: Hammer units). 1.0 plays wide stereo across both ears; 0.0 plays from a single 3D point.
tooltips.use_time_volume_mapping_curve: Enables 'time_volume_mapping_curve' to change volume while the sound plays.
tooltips.time_volume_mapping_curve: Controls how the volume multiplier (Y: typically 0.0 to 1.0) changes over playback time (X: seconds).
tooltips.use_time_unfiltered_stereo_mapping_curve: Enables 'time_unfiltered_stereo_mapping_curve' to change stereo width while the sound plays.
tooltips.time_unfiltered_stereo_mapping_curve: Controls how stereo spread (Y: 0.0 to 1.0) changes over playback time (X: seconds).
tooltips.use_doppler: Changes pitch when the sound source or listener moves fast (higher pitch when approaching, lower when moving away, like a passing siren).
tooltips.use_velocity_volume_curve: Enables 'velocity_volume_curve' so faster movement makes the sound louder.
tooltips.velocity_volume_curve: Controls how the volume multiplier (Y: typically 0.0 to 1.0) changes with movement speed (X: Hammer units per second).
tooltips.velocity_volume_seek_speed: Sets how fast the volume adapts to speed changes (units/s, >= 0, default: 700.0). Higher values react faster.
tooltips.use_velocity_eq: Changes the sound's tone filter based on movement speed. Used by 'csgo_surf' sliding sounds.
tooltips.use_impact_speed_input_volume_mapping_cu: Enables 'impact_speed_input_volume_mapping_curve' so harder physics collisions sound louder.
tooltips.impact_speed_input_volume_mapping_curve: Controls how the volume multiplier (Y: typically 0.0 to 1.0) changes with collision speed (X: units per second).
tooltips.occlusion: Legacy switch for wall blocking. For CS2 'csgo_mega' sounds, use 'occlusion_intensity' and 'use_baked_occlusion' instead.
tooltips.occlusion_intensity: Controls how much walls block the sound (default: 0.6). 0.0 = goes through walls at full volume; 1.0 = standard full wall blocking; values above 1.0 apply extra-heavy blocking.
tooltips.occlusion_frequency_scale: Controls how much walls muffle high frequencies (0.0 to 1.0, default: 1.0). 1.0 makes sounds behind walls sound dark and muffled.
tooltips.occlusion_interval: Sets how often the engine checks for walls between the sound and the listener (seconds, default: 0.1).
tooltips.use_baked_occlusion: Uses pre-calculated map acoustic data so sound travels realistically around corners and through doors.
tooltips.distance_effect_mix: Controls how much distant air-filtering applies as the player moves away (0.0 to 1.0, default: 1.0). 0.0 = off, 1.0 = full distant effect.
tooltips.reverb_wet: Controls how much room echo (reverb) is mixed into the sound (default: 1.0). 0.0 = dry (no echo), 1.0 = normal room echo, and values above 1.0 boost the echo.
tooltips.reverb_source_wet: Controls how much echo is generated at the sound source's own room location (0.0 to 1.0, default: 1.0).
tooltips.restrict_source_reverb: Limits the sound source's room reverb contribution to the final mix.
tooltips.dsp_preset: Selects a room echo style (such as small room, warehouse, or outdoor alley). Requires 'override_dsp_preset' to be true.
tooltips.override_dsp_preset: Forces this sound to use the selected 'dsp_preset' instead of the map's automatic room reverb.
tooltips.dsp_blend: Sets the mix strength of the forced 'dsp_preset' (0.0 to 1.0, default: 1.0). 0.0 = off, 1.0 = full preset reverb.
tooltips.dsp_bypass: Toggle value (0.0 = normal, 1.0 = bypass). Set to 1.0 to skip all room reverb and DSP audio effects.
tooltips.enable_child_events: Allows this sound to automatically trigger another sound event ('soundevent_01') at the same time.
tooltips.soundevent_01: Enter the name of the child sound event to trigger when this event starts (for example, 'Weapon_AK47.DistShoot').
tooltips.enable_retrigger: Automatically repeats the sound at random time intervals. Useful for ambient drops, birds, or sparks.
tooltips.retrigger_interval_min: Sets the minimum wait time before the sound repeats (seconds, >= 0, default: 1.0).
tooltips.retrigger_interval_max: Sets the maximum wait time before the sound repeats (seconds, >= 0, default: 3.0).
tooltips.retrigger_radius: Repeats the sound only when the listener is within this distance (Hammer units, default: 1000). 0 means no distance limit.
tooltips.retrigger_count: Sets the maximum number of repeats (default: -1). The leftmost slider position is 0; click DISABLE (or enter -1) for unlimited repeats.
tooltips.instance_limit: Limits how many copies of this sound can play at the same time (default: 0). 0 means no limit.
tooltips.self_destruct_time: Automatically fades out and stops the sound after this many seconds (default: -1.0). The leftmost slider position is 0.0; click DISABLE (or enter -1.0) to disable the timer.
tooltips.stop_at_time: Immediately cuts off the sound after this many seconds (default: -1.0). The leftmost slider position is 0.0; click DISABLE (or enter -1.0) to disable the timer.
tooltips.block_matching_events: Prevents this same sound event from starting again while the block timer ('block_duration') is active.
tooltips.block_match_entity: When blocking same events, blocks only repeats coming from the exact same entity.
tooltips.block_duration: Sets how many seconds to block new plays of this same sound event (seconds, >= 0, default: 0.1).
tooltips.block_distance: Blocks same events only within this distance (Hammer units, >= 0, default: 0). 0 blocks across the whole map.
tooltips.block_other: Prevents other sound events matching 'block_other_name' from starting.
tooltips.block_other_name: Enter a name or keyword (such as 'Footsteps') of other sound events to block.
tooltips.block_other_duration: Sets how many seconds to block matching other sound events (seconds, >= 0, default: 0.1).
tooltips.block_other_distance: Blocks matching other sound events within this distance (Hammer units, >= 0, default: 0).
tooltips.mixgroup: Assigns this sound to a CS2 mixer channel (such as 'Weapons', 'Footsteps', 'Ambient', or 'Music') to apply standard volume and routing rules.
tooltips.mixlayer_name: Enter the mixer layer name targeted by setter-type sound events.
tooltips.set_mixlayer_layer: Enter the mixer layer name to control over time with 'time_mixlayer_amount_curve'.
tooltips.set_mixlayer_amount_enable: Enables 'time_mixlayer_amount_curve' to dynamically adjust a mixer layer while this sound plays.
tooltips.time_mixlayer_amount_curve: Controls the strength (Y: 0.0 to 1.0) of the target mixer layer over playback time (X: seconds).
tooltips.use_volume_convar: Links the sound's volume to a game console setting ('volume_convar'), such as the player's music volume slider.
tooltips.volume_convar: Enter the console variable name that scales this sound's volume (for example, 'snd_menumusic_volume').
tooltips.should_queue_track: Places the track into the CS2 music queue so transitions align with musical beats ('syncpoints').
tooltips.update_track_syncpoint_index: Saves the chosen music variation number globally so follow-up music events stay on the same variation and beat.
tooltips.sync_action_to_startround: Toggle value (0 = off, 1 = on). Set to 1 to force this music event to use the same track variation chosen at the start of the round.
tooltips.startpoint_01: Sets the start time offset for music track 1 (seconds, >= 0, default: 0.0).
tooltips.startpoint_02: Sets the start time offset for music track 2 (seconds, >= 0, default: 0.0).
tooltips.startpoint_03: Sets the start time offset for music track 3 (seconds, >= 0, default: 0.0).
tooltips.endpoint_01: Sets the loop end time for music track 1 (seconds, >= 0). 0.0 plays to the end of the file.
tooltips.endpoint_02: Sets the loop end time for music track 2 (seconds, >= 0). 0.0 plays to the end of the file.
tooltips.endpoint_03: Sets the loop end time for music track 3 (seconds, >= 0). 0.0 plays to the end of the file.
tooltips.restart_startpoint_01: Sets the time where music track 1 jumps back to when it loops (seconds, >= 0, default: 0.0).
tooltips.restart_startpoint_02: Sets the time where music track 2 jumps back to when it loops (seconds, >= 0, default: 0.0).
tooltips.restart_startpoint_03: Sets the time where music track 3 jumps back to when it loops (seconds, >= 0, default: 0.0).
tooltips.syncpoints_01: Lists beat timestamps (in seconds, such as [0.0, 4.0, 8.0]) where music track 1 can smoothly transition to another track.
tooltips.syncpoints_02: Lists beat timestamps (in seconds) where music track 2 can smoothly transition to another track.
tooltips.syncpoints_03: Lists beat timestamps (in seconds) where music track 3 can smoothly transition to another track.
tooltips.stop_selection_music: Stops team-selection music ('Music.Selection.*') when this event starts.
tooltips.stop_all_non_music: Stops all non-music sound events when this music starts.
tooltips.stop_music: Stops all other playing 'Music.*' events when this event starts.
tooltips.stop_match_end: Stops match-end music ('Music.MatchEnd.*') when this event starts.
tooltips.stop_loading: Stops loading-screen music ('Music.LoadingScreen.*') when this event starts.
tooltips.join_non_mvp_group: Adds this track to the non-MVP music group so 'stop_music_except_mvp' can stop it.
tooltips.priority_override: Forces the music queue to use this event's 'priority' value instead of the default queue priority.
tooltips.stop_start_round: Stops round-start music ('Music.StartRound.*') when this event starts.
tooltips.stop_tensec_count: Stops 10-second countdown music ('Music.TenSecCount.*') when this event starts.
tooltips.stop_bomb_planted: Stops bomb-planted music ('Music.BombPlanted.*') when this event starts.
tooltips.stop_got_hostage: Stops hostage-rescued music ('Music.GotHostage.*') when this event starts.
tooltips.stop_music_except_mvp: Stops all music in the non-MVP group, but keeps MVP anthem music playing.
tooltips.skip_if_muted: Skips starting this music if its linked volume setting ('volume_convar') is set to 0.
tooltips.test_mvp_block: Checks whether MVP music is blocked before playing this event.
tooltips.check_for_classic_deathcam: Plays the classic 'Player.FreezeCam' sound if deathcam music volume is muted.
tooltips.stop_won_mvp: Stops round-win, round-loss, and MVP music when this event starts.
tooltips.block_won_lost: Blocks round-win and round-loss music from starting while this event plays.
tooltips.use_mode_music_volume: Applies the current game mode's music volume setting to this track.
tooltips.vsnd_files: Enter one or more '.vsnd' audio file paths (used by 'csgo_music' and 'csgo_movie'). Separate multiple paths with commas.
tooltips.vsnd_files_track_01: Enter one or more '.vsnd' audio file paths for track 1 (used by 'csgo_mega', 'csgo_ambient', and 'csgo_surf'). Separate multiple paths with commas to let the engine pick one on each play.
tooltips.source_soundscape: Enter the soundscape name referenced by this event.
tooltips.uiposition: Sets the [Left, Forward, Up] offset relative to the listener's head (no range limit). Requires 'use_uiposition' to be true.
tooltips.use_distance_pitch_mapping_curve: Enables 'distance_pitch_mapping_curve' to change pitch based on listener distance.
tooltips.distance_pitch_mapping_curve: Controls how pitch (Y) changes with distance (X: Hammer units).
tooltips.occlusion_path_curve: Controls how much indirect paths around walls quiet the sound when 'use_baked_occlusion' is enabled.
tooltips.doppler_factor: Sets the strength multiplier of the pitch increase when the sound moves toward the listener (>= 0.0, default: 1.0).
tooltips.doppler_factor_receding: Sets the strength multiplier of the pitch drop when the sound moves away from the listener (>= 0.0, default: 1.0).
tooltips.impact_speed_input: Sets a test impact speed value for previewing 'impact_speed_input_volume_mapping_curve' (units/s, >= 0).
tooltips.velocity_magnitude: Sets a test movement speed value for previewing speed-based curves (units/s, >= 0).
tooltips.voice_fade_out_time: Sets the quick fade-out time when the engine stops an active voice channel (seconds, >= 0, default: 0.0).
tooltips.voice_looped_culling_update_time: Sets how often the engine checks whether a looping sound is quiet enough to mute (seconds, default: 0.25).
tooltips.randomize_start_time: Starts playback at a random point inside the audio file. Prevents phasing when multiple copies of the same loop play together.
tooltips.retrigger_keepalive_override: Overrides how many seconds a repeating 'csgo_mega' event stays alive between repeats (seconds, >= 0, default: 0.0).

distance_unfiltered_stereo_mapping_curve.descY: Stereo spread (0.0 = 3D Point Source, 1.0 = Wide 2D Stereo)

time_unfiltered_stereo_mapping_curve.descY: Stereo spread (0.0 = 3D Point Source, 1.0 = Wide 2D Stereo)

occlusion_path_curve.descX: Sound path distance around obstacles (Hammer units)
occlusion_path_curve.descY: Wall blocking factor (0.0 = Clear, 1.0 = Fully Blocked)

csgo_mega.name: 3D World Sound (csgo_mega)
csgo_mega.desc: Standard 3D sound system (used by ~90% of CS2 sounds). Use for weapons, footsteps, explosions, doors, buttons, and point ambient sounds that need 3D distance drop-off, wall blocking, and room echo.

csgo_music.name: Interactive Music (csgo_music)
csgo_music.desc: Music system for menu themes, round start/end, bomb countdowns, and MVP anthems. Supports beat-synced transitions (syncpoints), smooth fade-outs, and round-state rules.

csgo_ambient.name: Map Entity Ambience (csgo_ambient)
csgo_ambient.desc: Area ambience system linked to map entities ('ambient_entity_name') such as 'snd_event_orientedbox', 'snd_event_sphere', or 'snd_event_point'. Use for rivers, waterfalls, wind zones, and machinery.

csgo_surf.name: Surf & Speed Slide (csgo_surf)
csgo_surf.desc: Speed-driven sound system. Changes volume and tone filter in real time based on how fast the player or object slides across a ramp, surface, or water.

csgo_movie.name: UI Video Audio (csgo_movie)
csgo_movie.desc: Audio player for Panorama UI video files (WebM/MP4) and background cutscenes.

guideModal.title: CS2 Map Sound Quick-Start Guide

concept.title: Core Concept: SoundEvents vs. Map Entities
concept.p1: 1. SoundEvent (.vsndevts file): Defines HOW the sound behaves (audio file path, volume, 3D distance drop-off, wall blocking, and room echo).
concept.p2: 2. Map Entity (in Hammer): Defines WHERE and WHEN the sound plays in your map (3D location, shape, and trigger inputs).

guideModal.entitiesTitle: Which Map Entity Should I Use?

entities.name: snd_event_point
entities.mechanism: Plays sound in all directions from one exact point in 3D space.
entities.scenario: Buttons, switches, sirens, small generators, and point sound effects.

entities.name: snd_event_sphere
entities.mechanism: Defines a sphere radius. The sound always plays from the point on the sphere closest to the player.
entities.scenario: Fireballs, energy cores, and large round machines.

entities.name: snd_event_orientedbox
entities.mechanism: Defines a 3D box (length, width, height). The sound follows the player along the closest face of the box.
entities.scenario: Rivers, wide waterfalls, air ducts, hallways, and shorelines.

entities.name: snd_event_cone
entities.mechanism: Points sound in one direction. Sounds loud and clear in front, and muffled behind.
entities.scenario: Wall speakers, megaphones, and directional alarms.

entities.name: snd_event_path_corner
entities.mechanism: Moves the sound smoothly along a chain of path nodes in the map.
entities.scenario: Flyby jets, moving trains, and ghosts in walls.

entities.name: snd_opvar_set_*
entities.mechanism: Does not play sound itself. Changes SoundEvent parameters based on player distance.
entities.scenario: Changing filter or mix levels when a player enters a room.

guideModal.stepsTitle: 5 Steps to Use Your Sound in CS2
steps: Copy Code: Choose a preset or adjust settings on the left, then click "Copy Code" in the top-right toolbar.
Paste into Addon: Open game/csgo_addons/<your_addon>/soundevents/soundevents_addon.vsndevts, paste the code at the bottom, and save.
Place Map Entity: In Hammer, place a sound entity (such as snd_event_point) and set its Sound Event Name property to your event name (for example, Weapon_Custom.Single).
Connect Trigger (Optional): To play the sound from a button (func_button), add an Output: OnPressed -> <Your Sound Entity> -> StartSound.
Test in Game: Compile your map (or recompile the .vsndevts file in Asset Browser), open the CS2 console, and run play <EventName> to test.

errors.EMPTY_DOCUMENT: The KV3 code is empty. Enter a valid SoundEvent block.
errors.UNCLOSED_QUOTE: Line {{line}}: Missing closing quote ("). Put all text values inside double quotes.
errors.UNEXPECTED_SEMICOLON: Line {{line}}: Remove the semicolon ';'. CS2 KV3 syntax does not use semicolons.
errors.CONSECUTIVE_DOTS: Line {{line}}: Remove the extra dot in '..'.
errors.CONSECUTIVE_COMMAS: Line {{line}}: Remove the extra comma in ',,'.
errors.LEADING_ARRAY_COMMA: Line {{line}}: Remove the comma right after '['.
errors.INVALID_NUMBER: Line {{line}}: Invalid number format. Use only one decimal point.
errors.UNEXPECTED_CLOSING_BRACE: Line {{line}}: Extra closing brace '}' has no matching '{'.
errors.UNEXPECTED_CLOSING_BRACKET: Line {{line}}: Extra closing bracket ']' has no matching '['.
errors.COMMA_OUTSIDE_ARRAY: Line {{line}}: Remove the comma ','. Do not put commas between properties outside '[ ]' arrays.
errors.STRAY_DOT: Line {{line}}: Invalid standalone dot '.'. Write decimal numbers with digits on both sides (for example, 0.5).
errors.MISSING_KEY: Line {{line}}: Add a property name before '='.
errors.INVALID_KEY_NAME: Line {{line}}: Invalid property name "{{key}}". Use only letters, numbers, and underscores.
errors.MISSING_VALUE: Line {{line}}: Add a value after '=' for property "{{key}}".
errors.INVALID_STATEMENT: Line {{line}}: Invalid syntax. Use 'key = value' format.
errors.NO_EVENT_FOUND: No SoundEvent found. Wrap your properties in "EventName" = { ... }.
errors.DUPLICATE_KEY: Line {{line}}: Duplicate property "{{key}}". Keep only one definition of each property.
errors.INVALID_PROPERTY_NUMBER: Line {{line}}: Property "{{key}}" requires a number, but got "{{actual}}".
errors.VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE: Line {{line}}: Property "{{key}}" must be within {{range}}, but got {{actual}}.
errors.INVALID_BOOLEAN: Line {{line}}: Property "{{key}}" requires true or false, but got "{{actual}}".
errors.INVALID_VECTOR_DIMENSION: Line {{line}}: Property "{{key}}" requires an array of {{expected}} numbers, but got {{actual}}.
errors.INVALID_WEIGHTS_DIMENSION: Line {{line}}: Property "{{key}}" requires an array of at least 2 numbers (for example, [ 0.8, 0.2 ]).
errors.INVALID_CURVE_FORMAT: Line {{line}}: Curve "{{key}}" requires at least 2 control points.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_PROPERTY_VALUE: Line {{line}}: Invalid value "{{actual}}" for "{{key}}". Allowed values: {{allowed}}.
errors.INVALID_MIN_MAX_PAIR: Line {{line}}: Minimum "{{minKey}}" ({{minVal}}) cannot be greater than maximum "{{maxKey}}" ({{maxVal}}).
errors.CHILD_MISSING_PARENT: Line {{line}}: To use "{{child}}", enable its master switch "{{parent}}" first.
errors.UNQUOTED_VALUE: Line {{line}}: Wrap text values for "{{key}}" in double quotes ("..."), or enter a valid number/boolean.
